blocks.content: Similar to an Euler trail, a path that visits every node in the graph exactly once is called a Hamilton path. The closed version of such a path is called a Hamilton cycle.
A Hamilton cycle exists if the minimum degree of a vertex in a graph with n vertices is greater than or equal to n/2.
